reason: Twenty bucks isn't the issue. My partner lives in WhatsApp and our shared list, and the Monday call already does the 'who's on what' job well enough. Moving both of us and all our household and business stuff into one more app is a fight I'm not picking for a tool I've only just heard of.
objection: Getting my partner to switch. If he doesn't open it every day, it's just me keeping a second copy of everything, and we'd still be chatting on WhatsApp anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If my partner tried the trial himself and said he actually liked it more than WhatsApp plus our list, I'd pay without thinking about it.
